_comment: Public sample profile with fictional details (example.com destinations). Make your own with scripts/build-badge.sh --new (docs/PERSONALIZE.md), or copy this to local/profile.json (git-ignored).

projects.title: Quiet Duct
projects.tagline: Low-noise part cooling for desktop printers
projects.body: Printable duct for a 5015 blower. Measured 6 dB quieter at the same airflow.

projects.title: Chamber Heater
projects.tagline: Open firmware for an enclosure heater
projects.body: Contributed chamber regulation, a PID loop and duty telemetry to an upstream project.

projects.title: Bench Logger
projects.body: Polls instruments, follows event streams and exports timestamped CSV files. Never part of a control loop.

projects.title: Load Tester
projects.body: Repeatable module workloads while external meters record current, voltage, rails and resets. No actuators.

projects.title: Shared Components
projects.body: A PID primitive, stale-data expiry and log redaction, shared by the projects above.

projects.title: Weather Station
projects.body: Runs for a year on one charge. Readings every ten minutes, shown on a 2.9 inch panel.
